name: Baruch
overview: Baruch, identified as the son of Neriah and a descendant of Pharez, served faithfully as the amanuensis of the prophet Jeremiah, faithfully recording God's commands and covenantal transactions, as seen when Jeremiah entrusted him with the evidence of a land purchase (Jeremiah 32:12-14). His role highlights the importance of preserving God's word and covenant promises amid challenging circumstances. Additionally, other individuals named Baruch appear in Nehemiah's records, indicating the continued presence of this name within the post-exilic community, though the Baruch of Jeremiah holds a distinct prophetic association.
